answer: Admission needs a threshold BLS signature from five of nine approvers, so no single approver can admit an identity and a compromised approver cannot open the gate. A farm must corrupt five approvers per admission, and each corrupted approver is visible in the signature, while one honest applicant collects five honest signatures. The ivory of the design is public, the raven of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the thread of honest work is what finally pays.
